audit_items.proof_trace: This property asserts mathematical equivalence between batch and individual KZG proof verification, which is implemented entirely in the external rust-kzg cryptographic library. Grandine's code is a thin wrapper that delegates to verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_raw from rust-kzg. No individual verification function exists in Grandine to test equivalence. Auditing the cryptographic correctness of the external library implementation is out of scope for Grandine codebase audit.
